## What changed

The business-day roll for the registration date lived in a single private helper, `toBusinessDay`, on `OwnerRestControllerV1` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`). It previously skipped only Saturdays and Sundays. I extended it to also roll past the fixed public-holiday list:
